text: Answers outright ($54.99 each at 18%) with a table of tip levels and the cent-rounding explained; any other tip or head count needs another message.
a2ui: Shows the precomputed answer and tip table with currency formatting, but with no arithmetic functions the sliders cannot change the result without a Recalculate round trip.
html: A true calculator: tip chips and slider, people stepper and round-up toggle recompute per-person cost in whole cents on every touch, with leftover and effective tip shown.
agui: Bill, people, tip and rounding come back as a tidy validated object, but a form cannot compute, so the page shows a static table until the agent replies.
